cues.en: Lots of words, especially in English, end up getting tokenized into a single token, often with a space in front of it.
cues.zh: 很多單字，尤其英文，最後會被切成單一 token，通常前面帶空白。

cues.en: And that makes doing research fairly straightforward, because one activations vector often corresponds
cues.zh: 這讓研究相當直接，因為一個活化向量，往往對應

cues.en: to one English word, but lots of other words are made up of multiple tokens.
cues.zh: 一個英文單字，但很多其他單字由多個 token 組成。

cues.en: So let's say you have a target word that you want to look at the activations for.
cues.zh: 假設有個目標單字，想查看它的活化。

cues.en: But that target word has 2 or 3 tokens, maybe even more tokens.
cues.zh: 但它有兩、三個，甚至更多 token。

cues.en: So what do you do?
cues.zh: 該怎麼辦？

cues.en: Answering that question is the goal of this video.
cues.zh: 回答這個問題，就是這部影片的目標。

cues.en: I will tell you what is the best thing to do and explain why.
cues.zh: 會告訴你最佳做法，並解釋原因。

cues.en: And then in the next video, you will use this knowledge to analyze category specific responses in MLP projections.
cues.zh: 下一部影片，會用這些知識，分析 MLP 投影的類別特定反應。

cues.en: So here you see three words that are multi Token words.
cues.zh: 這裡有三個多 token 單字。

cues.en: So let's look at toothpaste.
cues.zh: 先看 toothpaste。

cues.en: The word toothpaste comprises two tokens, one for space tooth and one for no space.
cues.zh: toothpaste 由兩個 token 組成，一個是空白加 tooth，另一個沒有空白，

cues.en: And then paste and time machine, I suppose, is technically two words.
cues.zh: 再接 paste；time machine 嚴格來說，應該是兩個單字。

cues.en: So therefore we have one token for each word.
cues.zh: 所以，每個單字各有一個 token。

cues.en: But there are plenty of situations where time machine is treated as if it were one word, so you wouldn't
cues.zh: 但很多情況會把 time machine 視為一個詞，

cues.en: want to use the word time without machine, and you wouldn't want to analyze the embeddings vectors for machine unless they were preceded by the token for time.
cues.zh: 不想只用 time 而沒有 machine，也不想分析 machine 的嵌入，除非前面有 time 的 token。

cues.en: So even though this might technically be two separate words for the purpose of analysis, we might often want to treat this as if it were one word.
cues.zh: 所以，技術上也許是兩個單字，但為了分析，經常希望視為一個詞。

cues.en: And here we have a hyphenated word which is represented by three tokens.
cues.zh: 這裡還有一個連字號單字，由三個 token 表示。

cues.en: So which of these tokens would you focus on if you wanted to do some analyses?
cues.zh: 如果想分析，會著重哪個 token？

cues.en: Perhaps you just look at the first token, or maybe the last token in this little mini sequence.
cues.zh: 也許只看第一個，或這段小序列的最後一個。

cues.en: Or maybe you take all of them and you average the embeddings, vectors and the activations and whatever else you're looking at.
cues.zh: 也許全部取出，把嵌入、向量、活化，或其他正在觀察的量，

cues.en: You would average them all together for all of the tokens.
cues.zh: 跨所有 token 全部取平均。

cues.en: If you would like to take a moment to think about this issue.
cues.zh: 如果想花點時間思考，

cues.en: Feel free to pause the video and give it some thought.
cues.zh: 可以暫停影片。

cues.en: So it turns out that the best approach is just to analyze the final token in the target word or phrase.
cues.zh: 最佳做法，是只分析目標單字或片語的最後一個 token。

cues.en: And the reason for this is that when the model sees the token for the word tooth, it does not yet know what token comes next.
cues.zh: 因為，模型看到 tooth 這個 token 時，還不知道接下來是哪個。

cues.en: It knows all the tokens that came before, and all of that contextual information gets loaded onto the embeddings vector for tooth.
cues.zh: 知道前面所有 token，而那些上下文資訊，會載入 tooth 的嵌入向量。

cues.en: But there's no guarantee that the next token will be paste.
cues.zh: 但不能保證下一個是 paste。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Now when the model actually sees the token for paste, especially with the preceding without the preceding space, and the previous token is for tooth.
cues.zh: 當模型真正看到 paste，尤其前面有，不，是沒有前導空白，而前一個 token 是 tooth，

cues.en: Then the vector, the embeddings vector for paste will be modulated such that or according to the information
cues.zh: paste 的向量、嵌入向量，就會受到調整，根據

cues.en: from the preceding token, which is truth, and then the model will know that this is toothpaste, which is different from any other kind of paste.
cues.zh: 前一個 tooth token 的資訊，讓模型知道這是 toothpaste，與其他 paste 不同。

cues.en: And toothpaste is also a very different word, with different meanings and implications compared to just tooth on its own.
cues.zh: 而 toothpaste，也與單獨 tooth 有非常不同的意義與含意。

cues.en: Another way to phrase this is that tooth doesn't know anything about paste, but paste knows a lot about tooth.
cues.zh: 換個方式說，tooth 不知道 paste，但 paste 知道很多 tooth 的資訊。

cues.en: So therefore the idea is that analyzing the token paste actually means also analyzing information about toothpaste.
cues.zh: 因此，分析 paste 這個 token，其實也就是分析 toothpaste 的資訊。

cues.en: Anyway, so that's the idea.
cues.zh: 總之，概念如此。
